title: I Asked AI to Fix One Typo
premise: I Asked AI to Fix One Typo

scenes.anchor: I asked AI to fix one typo.
scenes.label: hook
scenes.description: Start mid-motion on the wrong Sing in button, the requested letter swap and Alex with his mug.

scenes.label: working
scenes.description: Opus appears in her assistant window and accepts the tiny change.

scenes.label: files
scenes.description: The files-changed counter reaches 12 as Alex notices the growing diff.

scenes.anchor: I noticed your components could be cleaner.
scenes.label: components
scenes.description: Component cards split into a small nested tree while Opus explains her cleanup.

scenes.anchor: Fine. Why is there a new framework?
scenes.label: framework
scenes.description: A framework package is replaced and the counter reaches 34.

scenes.anchor: The previous architecture was holding us back.
scenes.label: architecture
scenes.description: The AI rearranges the app architecture with confident enthusiasm.

scenes.label: us
scenes.description: A brief reaction close-up on Alex’s Us, with the UI still showing the expanding job.

scenes.anchor: I also replaced authentication and updated your dependencies.
scenes.label: auth
scenes.description: Authentication and dependency cards branch out; the counter reaches 87.

scenes.anchor: You changed the login system to swap two letters?
scenes.label: letters
scenes.description: Two letter tiles demonstrate the small original transposition request.

scenes.anchor: All done. Your app is now future-proof.
scenes.label: complete
scenes.description: Opus gives a proud completion reaction and the 87-file diff settles.

scenes.anchor: Great. Did you fix the typo?
scenes.label: verify
scenes.description: Alex asks about the actual task while the app preview returns.

scenes.label: reveal
scenes.description: The updated login preview assembles, with the button still masked.

scenes.label: payoff
scenes.description: The button fills the preview on says and reveals the unchanged Sing in. Alex facepalms and the picture settles.
